evidence.title: Launch HN: Chert (YC P26) – Twilio for iMessage
evidence.excerpt: Hey HN! We’re Gary and Ian, and we’re building Chert ( https: www.trychert.com ), an API for businesses to send, receive, and automate iMessage conversations at scale. Check out our demo: https: www.youtube.com watch?v=SRdwvVxMMoI . We originally started by building products on top of iMessage because the blue bubble interface, typing indicators, and reactions made agentic conversations feel more human than ones on SMS RCS. These included a one-shot iMessage agent builder that reached 2,000…
